message:
fix(host): read the secure-input target rect live from the captured monitor and re-check it every second

Follow-up to 03b0d13 (P9) after review: a display arrangement change that keeps the
resolution -- the primary moved, a monitor re-ordered -- changes the origin without a
size change, so no capture restart follows and the restart-time sync alone would miss it.

- sync_input_target_rect() now queries GetMonitorInfo on the HMONITOR the capture session
  opened instead of the cached geometry (falls back to it when the handle is gone).
- The stats stage calls it once a second (reason=periodic): one query and a compare, a
  push and a log line only when the rect changed.
- Test: an origin-only change at the same size is a change and maps to the new origin.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
